description: `(expression for item in items if condition)`: a comprehension that produces a lazy, one-shot generator instead of a list.
Returns the first remaining item, or `default` when the iterator is exhausted; the idiom for "first match or default".
`any`, `all`, `next` and `in` stop pulling as soon as the answer is known, so later items are never computed.
Turning a lazy iterable into a list with `list(...)` or a list comprehension, paying for every item at once.
A generator can be consumed once; two consumers of the same generator share its position.
